# 1 Enoch Chapter 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**51:1** In those days the earth will give back everything that has been entrusted to it. Sheol will give back all it has received. And the realm of the dead will give back what it owes.

**51:2** For in those days the Elect One will rise up. He will select the righteous and holy from among all of them, for the time of their salvation will have arrived.

**51:3** In those days the Elect One will take his seat on my throne, and all the secrets of wisdom and counsel will pour from his mouth — for the Lord of Spirits has given these to him and glorified him.

**51:4** In those days the mountains will leap like rams, and the hills will skip like well-fed lambs. The faces of all the angels in heaven will shine with joy.

**51:5** The earth will rejoice. The righteous will live upon it, and the chosen will walk across it.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 51 is the resurrection chapter of the Parables. Verse 1's triple statement — earth gives back, Sheol gives back, hell gives back — is one of the clearest affirmations of bodily resurrection in all of Second Temple Judaism. The imagery of leaping mountains (v. 4) is drawn from Psalm 114, applied now to the cosmic joy of resurrection.*
